hr: U salonu Vas dočekuju Ivanka, vlasnica, i Valentina.

Radimo sve frizerske usluge, a najviše volimo boju: od njege prirodne nijanse do pastelnih i neonskih tonova koje ćete vidjeti u galeriji. Radimo s profesionalnim bojama Matrix, Schwarzkopf Professional i Artego.
en: You will be welcomed by Ivanka, the owner, and Valentina.

We do all hairdressing services, and colour is what we love most: from caring for a natural shade to the pastel and neon tones you will see in the gallery. We work with professional colour from Matrix, Schwarzkopf Professional and Artego.

alt.hr: Ivanka i Valentina, frizerke salona Ivanka
alt.en: Ivanka and Valentina, the hairdressers of Salon Ivanka

_services_upute: Cijenu upišite kao tekst, npr. "od 20 €" ili "25 €". Prazno ("") znači 'Cijena na upit'. Stavke (items) su neobavezne.

desc.hr: Žensko šišanje, feniranje, kovrče i ravnanje – za svaki dan i za posebne prilike.
desc.en: Women's haircuts, blow-dries, curls and straightening, for every day and for special occasions.

desc.hr: Bojanje cijele kose, pramenovi, balayage i posvjetljivanje – plave, srebrne, bakrene i crvene nijanse.
desc.en: Full colour, highlights, balayage and lightening, from blondes and silvers to coppers and reds.

desc.hr: Pastelne i neonske nijanse, ružičasta, ljubičasta, plava, dugine boje. Ono po čemu nas prepoznaju.
desc.en: Pastel and neon shades, pink, violet, blue, rainbow colour. What we are known for.

desc.hr: Punđe, pletenice i valovi za vjenčanja, mature i proslave.
desc.en: Updos, braids and waves for weddings, proms and celebrations.

desc.hr: Njega i tretmani za kosu nakon bojanja i posvjetljivanja, profesionalnim proizvodima.
desc.en: Care and treatments for hair after colouring and lightening, with professional products.
